missions.name: Coastal Intercept
missions.briefing: Break the coastal strike group before it reaches the fleet anchorage.

missions.name: Refinery Run
missions.briefing: Cut through the refinery corridor and destroy the mobile command train.

missions.name: Black Sea
missions.briefing: Strike the carrier screen and survive the missile cruiser counterattack.

missions.name: Breakwater
missions.briefing: Punch through the reinforced breakwater screen and eliminate the rebuilt command gunship.

missions.name: Furnace Line
missions.briefing: Return to the furnace corridor, collapse its heavy air-defence belt and stop the command train before it reaches the tunnel complex.

missions.name: Black Flag
missions.briefing: Lead the final sea strike through missile corvettes and fast attack craft, then finish the cruiser before the fleet escapes the combat zone.

missions.name: Desert Lance
missions.briefing: Race the Khamsin armoured column across the salt flats and cut its railhead before the mobile fortress reaches the mountain tunnels.

missions.name: River Hammer
missions.briefing: Follow the flooded Kestrel valley under its bridge network, break the patrol flotilla and stop the missile cruiser from shelling the evacuation corridor.

missions.name: Mountain Eye
missions.briefing: Climb through the Karakoram storm wall, blind the mercenary over-horizon radar and duel its command gunship above the snow line.

missions.name: Night Harbor
missions.briefing: Lead the blackout strike into Port Vesper, destroy the mercenary command fleet and expose the autonomous weapons shipment hidden beneath the harbor.

missions.name: Ghost Sky
missions.briefing: Unknown autonomous contacts have seized the upper cloud deck. Break the swarm and destroy the airborne controller before it can propagate the network.

missions.name: Machine Furnace
missions.briefing: The mercenary furnace complex is manufacturing autonomous armour. Fight through human holdouts and machine defences, then destroy the forge core.

missions.name: Broken Truce
missions.briefing: Machines are attacking both armies along the Vesper coast. Hold a temporary ceasefire corridor, then destroy the controller overriding every weapon in range.

missions.name: Dead Factory
missions.briefing: Enter a lights-out weapons plant that continues building armour without workers. Trace the assembly line to the self-directed forge core.

missions.name: Iron Rain
missions.briefing: Autonomous bombers are seeding the cloud deck with hunter drones. Climb through the falling machines and kill their airborne shepherd.

missions.name: Ghost Convoy
missions.briefing: A driverless supply column is crossing the abandoned city belt. Follow its dead radio traffic and destroy the train carrying the network's mobile seed foundry.

missions.name: Red Circuit
missions.briefing: Strike the machine-modified coastal power grid before its field array links the surviving factories into one hardened combat network.

missions.name: Swarm Sea
missions.briefing: The network is using abandoned ships as floating drone cradles. Burn through the launch tide and sink the controller before the swarm reaches open ocean.

missions.name: Silent City
missions.briefing: Enter the evacuated Meridian industrial district, where the network has turned tower foundations and rail tunnels into a distributed factory.

missions.name: Machine Crown
missions.briefing: Assault the airborne relay crown that synchronizes the machine war. Its destruction opens the only viable path into the upper atmosphere.

missions.name: Black Horizon
missions.briefing: Climb through the upper atmosphere and sever the autonomous network at its first orbital command node before it can coordinate global drone production.

missions.name: Blue Fire
missions.briefing: The AI has begun deploying field-coupled interceptors above the storm deck. Break the phase screen and destroy the control array before it stabilises a permanent high-altitude exclusion zone.

missions.name: Cold Station
missions.briefing: Assault the autonomous transfer station while its defensive grid is still incomplete. Destroy the Warden before the AI can convert the station into a permanent weapons foundry.

missions.name: Thin Blue Line
missions.briefing: Defend the last atmospheric relay while the VX-94 receives its orbital flight package, then climb through the machine blockade guarding the blue line.

missions.name: Kinetic Dawn
missions.briefing: Escort Longshot targeting packages across sunrise orbit and seize the unfinished rail platform before its Warden turns the weapon on Earth.

missions.name: Orbitfall
missions.briefing: Machine debris is being deorbited onto allied launch sites. Enter the falling wreckage stream and sever the command node steering the bombardment.

missions.name: Dead Satellite
missions.briefing: Board the shadow of a dead reconnaissance lattice, recover its intelligence core and destroy the Warden nesting inside its collapsed antenna field.

missions.name: Black Sky
missions.briefing: The final operation begins. Tear open the network's planetary field curtain and mark the Machine Ark's escape orbit for the allied fleet.

missions.name: Last Horizon
missions.briefing: Hold the Ark in Earth orbit while allied kinetic batteries align. Break its outer command shell and survive the last horizon before the final assault.

missions.name: Machine Ark
missions.briefing: The autonomous war has condensed into a mobile orbital command ark carrying factories, strategic weapons and the surviving network core. Break its escort and end the machine offensive before it can leave Earth orbit.
